title: Tracing Hallucinations in LLM Reasoning for UML Class Diagram Generation: An Empirical Taxonomy and Mitigation Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.30946v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate UML class diagrams from natural language requirements, but hallucinations may compromise the correctness and completeness of the resulting diagrams. Existing evaluations mostly assess the final diagram, without examining the intermediate traces of reasoning-capable LLMs, which can reveal where these hallucinations arise. We develop an empirical taxonomy of eleven hallucination sub-types organised into three dimensions: Prompt Faithfulness (deviations between requirements and reasoning), Code Faithfulness (discrepancies between reasoning and generated PlantUML code), and Reasoning Quality (problems within the reasoning). The taxonomy was derived from 60 manually annotated DeepSeek-R1 traces, applied to 120 further DeepSeek-R1 traces through a dual-LLM annotation pipeline, and examined on 20 DeepSeek-V4-Pro traces. Code Faithfulness was the most frequent dimension for DeepSeek-R1 in both datasets

translated_title: 追踪大语言模型在UML类图生成中的推理幻觉：实证分类体系与缓解研究
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）能够根据自然语言需求生成UML类图，但幻觉问题可能会损害生成图的正确性和完整性。现有的评估方法大多只关注最终生成的图，而没有检查具备推理能力的LLM的中间推理轨迹，而这些轨迹可以揭示幻觉产生的位置。我们构建了一个包含十一种幻觉子类型的实证分类体系，分为三个维度：提示忠实度（需求与推理之间的偏差）、代码忠实度（推理与生成的PlantUML代码之间的差异）以及推理质量（推理过程内部的问题）。该分类体系基于60条人工标注的DeepSeek-R1推理轨迹构建，通过双LLM标注流水线应用于另外120条DeepSeek-R1轨迹，并在20条DeepSeek-V4-Pro轨迹上进行了验证。在两个数据集中，代码忠实度都是DeepSeek-R1中出现频率最高的幻觉维度。
tldr: 该研究针对LLM生成UML类图过程中的推理幻觉，构建了包含提示忠实度、代码忠实度和推理质量三个维度共十一种子类型的实证分类体系，并发现代码忠实度错误是出现频率最高的幻觉类型。
en_tdlr: This study develops an empirical taxonomy of eleven hallucination sub-types across three dimensions (Prompt Faithfulness, Code Faithfulness, and Reasoning Quality) for LLM-based UML class diagram generation, finding that Code Faithfulness errors are the most frequent hallucination category.
